items.title: Why Candace Cameron Bure Thinks ‘DWTS’ Was Harder Than ‘Special Forces’
items.summary:
Candace Cameron Bure has now tried her hand at both Dancing With the Stars and Special Forces: World’s Toughest Test , and one of those reality TV shows seemed harder in her mind.

“You said to me before the show started, this was the hardest thing you ever did, Miss Special Forces . And then you said …” Maria Menounos said on the Tuesday, November 17, episode of the “Heal Squad” podcast, to which Cameron Bure, 50, replied, “What did I say? I said, ‘ Special Forces was easy compared to Dancing With the Stars .’”

Cameron Bure went on to note that she wanted Menounos to “take that statement with a grain of salt,” explaining that the two reality shows are “completely different types of challenges.”

“ Dancing With the Stars , it was live television,” she said. “The pressure of the live television and then having no dance experience and the further I got, the more I was just mentally sinking because the pressure was getting to me.”

Candace Cameron Bure Reveals Why She Was 'Ready to Quit' on 'Special Forces' 

The Full House alum, however, noted that she was “not competing against anyone else” on Special Forces, but rather on a journey by herself.

“There’s no eliminations on Special Forces ,” she noted. “The only way you leave is if you tap out or they remove you for some reason — usually a medical reason or if they think you’re not mentally fit. If there’s something wrong there, they could remove you. So the pressure was different, and I would say that pressure was greater for me on Dancing With the Stars. ”

Cameron Bure clarified that she was not “scared” of the audience…
items.t: Why Candace Cameron Bure Thinks ‘DWTS’ Was Harder Than ‘Special Forces’

items.title: 'Big Brother' Alum Aaryn Williams 'Slept With a Woman' in the Jury House
items.summary:
Big Brother alum Aaryn Williams is opening up about her tenure in the show’s jury house.

“I was on Big Brother in 2013,” Aaryn, 36, began a confessional in the Small Town Trouble: Texas pilot, recalling her reality TV past. “The first time I slept with a woman was in the Big Brother jury house and I was 23.”

Aaryn is now married to Nick Williams , whom she confided in about her bisexuality when they started dating.

“I remember you told me about it,” Nick, 38, told his wife in a confessional. “It was in a wine cellar that you guys weren’t even supposed to be drinking wine, but you broke into the wine cellar.”

'Small Town Trouble: Texas' Premiere Reveals Which Housewives Are Hooking Up 

Aaryn quickly clarified that she didn’t “break in” to the pantry.

“When I met Nick, I had actually just come off of Big Brother . The ironic thing about that is that when I was on Big Brother , I was the worst version of myself ,” she noted. “I was extremely racist and homophobic. I mean, I had a lot of self-hatred.”

Throughout Aaryn’s time in the Big Brother house during season 15, she made various racist and homophobic comments . She publicly apologized during a live exit interview.

Giselle Hernandez/Bravo 
 “I have said some things that have been taken completely out of context and wrong,” she said at the time. “I do not mean to ever come off racist; that’s not me, and I apologize to anyone that I’ve offended for that.”

items.title: The Amazing Race's Riley Shares How Journey Prepared Her for Motherhood
items.summary:
The Amazing Race season 39’s Riley Tejcek just finished her race around the world with mom Ann-Marie Tejcek . Now, she’s ready to take on her own motherhood journey.

“My mom is the backbone of our team, and I think you saw that she was the strength,” Riley, 29, exclusively told Us on Thursday, November 19, after she and Ann-Marie, 56, were eliminated from the race during the previous night’s episode. “I mean, I’m on the mat biting my tongue, trying not to look like weak, and she’s being able to laugh and fight. … She’s saying, ‘It’s not over ‘til you leave the mat.’”

Riley continued, “What it taught me is what true strength, what protection looks like. Like, she was protecting me in that moment, she knew that if she got emotional, it would only make me worse. So she [started] making jokes and knew how to make me laugh, but also showing me that she was never going to stop fighting.”

Riley announced in August, weeks before season 39 premiered, that she and her husband had welcomed their first baby, a son named Miles. The Marine officer shared that her experience with her own mom on the race taught her that she wants to make sure her son knows she’ll always “protect him.”

Amazing Race’s Matt and Michelle Defend Their ‘Cutthroat’ Gameplay Strategy 

“I would go to the end of the earth, like my mom did, to support him, and even when he is devastated and heartbreak comes his way, that I’m right there to pick him up and lift him up and show him love and kindness,” she told Us .

items.title: Foster Mom Killed 5-Year-Old for Having Snacks in Bed: 'Robbed of a Childhood'
items.summary:
An Ohio woman confessed to police she suffocated her 5-year-old foster son because he had snacks in his bed at night, according to prosecutors, who said she also revealed she dumped his body in a sewer drain.

On Thursday, November 19, a judge sentenced Pammy Maye to 29 years to life in prison in the killing of Darnell Taylor in Columbus in February 2024, per CBS affiliate WBNS-TV .

“To murder a defenseless, innocent, 5-year-old child is evil, wicked, heartless, cruel and thoughtless,” the boy’s grandmother, Shanda McGee , said in court, according to the TV station. “My grandson Darnell did not deserve to be murdered.”

Maye, 51, was found guilty on November 10 of aggravated murder, three counts of tampering with evidence and abuse of a corpse in connection with Darnell’s death, the Franklin County Prosecutor’s Office said in a news release.

Babysitter Sentenced for Murdering Missing Boy After She Helped With Search 

Her sentencing comes more than two years after Maye’s husband called Columbus police on Valentine’s Day in 2024, saying she murdered their foster son, according to prosecutors. Maye reportedly killed Darnell after the boy brought a granola bar and peanut butter crackers to his bed.

In a 911 call, Maye’s husband said that around 3:00 a.m., Maye entered their bedroom and revealed Darnell was dead before she fled their home in a silver Jeep Cherokee. This led her husband to quickly call 911 after he couldn’t find Darnell, prosecutors said.

Maye abandoned her Jeep, which was found about two hours later in a parking lot of the Cleveland suburb of Brooklyn,…
items.t: Foster Mom Killed 5-Year-Old for Having Snacks in Bed: 'Robbed of a Childhood'

There’s always some room for romance on Tulsa King — at least for Garrett Hedlund and Scarlet Stallone ‘s characters.

In Us’ exclusive sneak peek at the Friday, November 20, episode of the hit Paramount+ show, Mitch (Hedlund) and Spencer (Stallone) discuss trying to make “real money” by fixing an upcoming horse race.

Mitch thinks they have to “bet so high” to make it work , but Spencer suggests arranging the situation in their favor. This leads to a flirty moment between the characters, inspiring Mitch to make a move.

“I think we should discuss this at that dinner we were talking about,” he says, and Spencer agrees.

'Tulsa King' Reveals Cast Changes for Season 5 After Surprise Relocation 

The lighthearted moment is a welcome change after a season of ups and downs. When Tulsa King returned in October, viewers were surprised by a major shakeup that led to Margaret ( Dana Delany ) and Thresher’s ( Neal McDonough ) deaths.

At the time, Hedlund, 42, and Frank Grillo weighed in on what the shocking development would mean for the rest of the season.

“Without Sylvester Stallone, there is no such thing as the show Tulsa King. It doesn’t exist,” Grillo, 61, exclusively told Us. “There’s no iteration like Yellowstone where [Kevin] Costner goes away and there’s still a Yellowstone. If Stallone goes away, there’s no Tulsa King.”

Grillo continued: “So having that element — having that key person — who is at the top … everybody [else] is expendable. Everybody — even the ones you love and you think are safe. It’s kind of the way it’s going to happen with all the characters.”…
items.t: Garrett Hedlund, Scarlet Stallone Get Flirty in 'Tulsa King' Sneak Peek

items.title: Jackson 5's Marlon Jackson Reveals Stage 4 Prostate Cancer Diagnosis
items.summary:
Jackson 5 member Marlon Jackson is opening up about his stage IV cancer diagnosis for the first time.

“I’m going to tell people right now, God has me. He already told me he has me,” Jackson, 69, shared on the Tuesday, November 17, episode of Farah Shammas ’ podcast . “I’ve had [prostate] cancer for four years. But don’t worry about it. God got me. Everything is great.”

According to the Mayo Clinic , prostate cancer is one of the most common types of cancer. Most people with the diagnosis can be cured with proper treatment.

Jackson said he already had his prostate gland removed and underwent radiation treatment.

Summer House’s Jesse Solomon Opens Up About Testicular Cancer Journey 

“I’m great. I’m good. Bad grass don’t die,” he joked. “I’m going to be around for a long time.”

To stay healthy, Jackson said he tries his best to walk almost four miles at least four times a week. While he stopped eating beef and pork in 1977, the singer has recently taken additional steps to improve his diet.

“I did away with sugar,” he explained. “I’m careful with what I put in my body and try to take care of myself.”

Jackson said his faith has also been a big help in keeping him focused on better tomorrows as he navigates a serious diagnosis.

Marlon Jackson Courtesy of The Farah Shammas Podcast/YouTube 
 “I’m doing great. I thank everybody who has prayed for me,” he said. “The Lord told me, ‘Cast your burdens on him, and he’ll take care of them,’ and that’s what he’s done so I can’t complain. Even my doctor said, ‘You’re doing so much better than what I thought.’”

items.title: Roseanne Barr Says She Has ‘No Sexual Desire’ After 14 Years of Celibacy
items.summary:
Roseanne Barr is making a candid confession about her sex life.

“I have no sexual interest or desire,” Barr, 74, said during her appearance on the Wednesday, November 18, episode of Christina Pazsitzky ’s “ Your Mom’s House ” podcast while discussing a trip to Saint Barthélemy.

“I want to go to St. Barts and bang out some French dudes ‘cause I’m newly single,” Pazsitzky, 50, said. “Are you single now?”

Barr responded with a smile, “I guess.”

“You don’t want to f*** anymore?” Pazsitzky asked.

Barr explained, “Every so often, a fleeting thought will enter, and then run as fast as it f***ing can from my mind. But now, I don’t have the sex drive now that I’m [74]. All my friends are like, ‘You’ve got to get on the hormones and get your sex drive back.’ Why? My sex drive cost me everything. It was a f***ing devil.”

Tom Arnold Reacts to Ex Roseanne Barr Defending Him: 'Hell Froze Over Today' 

The Roseanne alum added, “I had to join the 12-step program of giving up my addiction to d***, and it’s been the best thing. I’ve been sober now from d*** for, let’s see, what is it? … I was with somebody, but we never f***ed for seven years. So 14 years I have been — what do they call that? Where they deprogram you from being d***matized?”

Barr said she prefers her celibate lifestyle.

“Now that I’ve got my clarity back and my clitoris is freed from its burdens, I have time to actually ponder the world and how I can fix it,” she concluded. “And being a Jewish grandmother, that is, of course, paramount in my mind.”

Barr has been married three times : to Bill Pentland from 1974 to…

items.title: What Was Susan Smith’s Sentence? Inside Murder Case After She Was Denied Parole
items.summary:
Susan Smith was unanimously denied parole 30 years after she admitted to drowning her two young sons in a South Carolina lake, bringing fresh attention to one of the most notorious crimes of the 1990s and the life sentence she is still serving.

Smith appeared virtually at her parole hearing on November 19, 2026, where she asked the board to grant her release. A forensic psychiatrist, a prison guard and two of her brothers spoke on her behalf, while her ex-husband, David Smith , urged the board to keep her behind bars.

Keep scrolling for more details on Susan’s sentence following her hearing:

SC Child Killer Susan Smith Has 2nd Parole Hearing Scheduled for This Fall 

Inside Susan Smith’s Prison Sentence 
 In 1994, Susan rolled her car into John D. Long Lake in South Carolina with her two sons, Michael and Alex, strapped inside. The boys — 3 years old and 14 months old at the time — drowned.

Susan initially told authorities that her children had been taken during a carjacking, a story that captured national attention as she publicly pleaded for their safe return. Nine days later, she confessed that she had killed them.

One year after the crime, Susan was sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole after 30 years. That sentence set the timeline for the parole hearings she has faced over the past two years, both of which have ended with the board voting unanimously to keep her incarcerated.

items.title: Eva Longoria Shares How Motherhood Changed the Way She Works: 'Easy to Say No'
items.summary:
Eva Longoria has acting down to a science, but becoming a mother unlocked something in her she didn’t expect: the ability to say “no.”

Longoria, 51, exclusively told Us on Wednesday, November 18, that parenthood taught her “priorities” after welcoming son Santiago “Santi” in June 2018 .

“I mean, really, it’s been so great to have somebody else as your center of your universe,” she explained while attending the L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration. “You know, when it’s you, you feel like, ‘I gotta say yes to everything.’”

The Land of Women star revealed that her perspective of work-life balance shifted dramatically after she and husband José “Pepe” Bastón had someone else to think about.

Eva Longoria. Amy Sussman/Getty Images 
 “Once I had my son, it was so easy to say no because if it pulled [me] away from him, I was like, ‘I can’t do it. I can’t go. I can’t film that. I can’t shoot that,’” Longoria shared. “So it’s been nice.”

The Desperate Housewives alum also told Us that her son looking up to her has only strengthened her ability to know her worth as a person and an actress.

“It’s funny because he usually gets mad when I have to go to work or when I have to leave [for] a trip. He’s like, ‘Why do you have to go to work every day?’” Longoria explained. “And I said, ‘You know, Mommy’s going after her dreams. Mommy has a dream, and I work at it every day.’”

Eva Longoria Explains Why She Waited Until She Was 43 to Become a Mother 

She continued, “Now when I leave [for] work or drop him off at school, he’s like, ‘Are you going to go work on your dream today?’ And…
items.t: Eva Longoria Shares How Motherhood Changed the Way She Works: 'Easy to Say No'

After a pause, Kelce tried to explain why she doesn’t answer everything in her “Ask Me ‘Some’ Things” podcast segment.

“Yes, that audible groan is the proper response. What the actual f***?” she said. “Next time you guys ask me, ‘Why Kylie do you call it ask me some things?’ Because this is the ridiculous s*** that ends up in our inbox. Thank you very much.”

Kylie Kelce Reveals the 'Best Marriage Advice' She's Ever Gotten 

Kylie continued, “I suppose you could put some cinnamon sticks, or you didn’t want to know spices? Oh, got it.”

Jason, 39, and Kylie met on Tinder in 2014 before marrying in April 2018. He was drafted by the Philadelphia Eagles during the 2011 NFL Draft and announced his retirement from the league more than a decade later in March 2024.

The couple are now parents to four daughters, including Wyatt, 7, Ellie, 5, Bennie, 3, and Finn, 19 months.

“Domino’s firstborn, Cass, … he’s my stepson, and he’s going to be 18 very soon. He’s in his senior year of high school,” Badgley noted on Wednesday’s episode. “I met him when he was 5. His father’s very much in his life and always has been since I met them.”

items.title: Body Found Inside Trunk Leads to 2 Arrests After Deadly Argument
items.summary:
Two men were arrested in Florida after police said several witnesses called 911 about a body inside the trunk of a car.

Kain Kerper , a convicted felon, is charged with second-degree murder and Ragan Rowland , is charged with accessory after the fact in connection with the person’s death, according to a Wednesday, November 18, news release from the St. Johns County Sheriff’s Office .

Authorities responded to the 911 call reporting a body in a car in St. Augustine around 5:45 a.m. on Wednesday when deputies arrived and found the person dead inside the trunk, the sheriff’s office said.

An investigation revealed Kerper, 24, fatally shot the person in St. Augustine, before their body was loaded into a car that was driven to a different site in the city, according to authorities. The person’s identity hasn’t been specified by law enforcement.

Woman Killed Sleeping Boyfriend, Dismembered Body Before Burying Him in Yard 

The shooting was the result of an argument involving Kerper and the person, the sheriff’s office said. The agency didn’t detail the nature of the dispute or how the argument began.

“Multiple witnesses were interviewed and detectives identified a third person, Rowland as an accomplice in the murder,” the sheriff’s office said.

St. Augustine police arrested Kerper and Rowland, 35, at a local home, according to authorities.

Kerper’s arrest comes months after his release from state prison in August, First Coast News reported.

He previously served nearly two and a half years in prison for having a gun, despite being a convicted felon, per the outlet. In 2021,…
items.t: Body Found Inside Trunk Leads to 2 Arrests After Deadly Argument

items.title: David Beckham's perfume, Poundland – and a mighty, mighty stink | Arwa Mahdawi
items.summary:
The Beckhams have made an art of monetising their every move. But apparently there are limits to where they’re prepared to sell their wares

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
